MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 5 12-07-2024 Heard the parties.
2. The petitioners are in judicial custody in connection with Economic Offence P.S. Case No. 13 of 2023 for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, Patna High Court CR.

entities.text: Economic Offence P.S. Case No. 13 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
MISC. No.10770 of 2024(5) dt.12-07-2024 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code and 66(c), 66(D) I.T.
Act lodged on 27.9.2023 by the informant, Mithilesh Kumar.

3. As per the prosecution story, the informant who is the SHO, Economic Offence, upon secret information that fraud calls are being made for loan approval by particular numbers xxxxx11704 and xxxxx91995 respectively as also for setting in STET exams, formed a team and made a raid in which it came to notice that it is the petitioner, Subodh Rout who trains the accused persons while the amount that was being received through the crime goes to the account of the another petitioner,
Chandan Kumar.
When the police reached Shishupal's house and search made, number of SIM cards, mobile phones and other things recovered/seized.

The accused persons who were present,
accepted the said facts and named these two petitioners who were able to escape through narrow lane.
Accordingly, the FIR.
4. Learned Senior Counsel appearing for both the petitioners submit that admittedly, so far as the two brothers are concerned, the allegation is that they used to sell data @ Rs. 35 per person.

His submission is that against Subodh Rout and Chandan Kumar, there is/are allegation of of training the young people as also the amount coming to the account of Chandan Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.10770 of 2024(5) dt.12-07-2024 Kumar.
The further submission is that charge-sheet has already been submitted and charges too have been framed and they undertake to diligently appear in trial.
Last submission is that while the petitioner, Krishna Murari has no criminal antecedent, the accused Kanhaiya Prasad has one criminal antecedent.
Both are in judicial custody since 28.9.2023.

5. Learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the Economic Offences Unit submits that a perusal of the FIR would show that innocent people are being cheated by these people and Subodh Rout the trainer whereas the amount used to come in the account of Chandan Kumar.
Further, there is allegation against one Shishupal Kumar that he committeed fraud upon the lady who had coughed up Rs. 80,000/-.

6. Taking into account the aforesaid facts as also that they have remained in custody for almost nine months, charge- sheet submitted and charges already framed, they undertake to diligently appear in trial, this Court is inclined to extend them the privilege of bail.
However, if it found that the charges have not been framed, the petitioners should be released only after framing of the charges.
